title: Policy is bypassed if the file is opened in the IDE

triage_metadata.reasoning: No source files were pruned; all PR modifications directly address the reported issue.

summary.problem: The A2A server in Gemini CLI does not load default security policies, causing policy checks to be bypassed and inconsistent policy enforcement compared to interactive CLI mode.
summary.root_cause: In `packages/a2a-server/src/config/config.ts`, `loadConfig` previously set `policyEngineConfig` with an empty rules array in non-YOLO mode instead of invoking `createPolicyEngineConfig` from `@google/gemini-cli-core`. Additionally, workspace settings were loaded unconditionally without verifying folder trust via `checkPathTrust`, allowing workspace settings to potentially override `policyPaths` and `adminPolicyPaths`.
summary.context: To achieve parity with the CLI policy engine, default policies must be initialized through `createPolicyEngineConfig`, and path trust boundaries must be strictly enforced when loading settings in `a2a-server`.

steps: In `packages/a2a-server/src/types.ts`, extend `AgentSettings` with an optional `isTrusted?: boolean` field.

In `packages/a2a-server/src/config/settings.ts`, update `loadSettings(workspaceDir: string, isTrustedOverride?: boolean)` to perform a folder trust check using `checkPathTrust` when `isTrustedOverride` is undefined, only load `workspaceSettings` if `isTrusted` evaluates to true, and override `policyPaths` and `adminPolicyPaths` on the merged result to strictly use `userSettings` values.

In `packages/a2a-server/src/config/config.ts`, update `loadConfig` to accept `trusted: boolean = false`. Construct `PolicySettings` with `mcpServers`, mapped `tools` (core, exclude, allowed), `policyPaths`, and `adminPolicyPaths`, then call `createPolicyEngineConfig(policySettings, approvalMode, undefined, true)` to generate `policyEngineConfig` instead of returning empty rules.
In `packages/a2a-server/src/agent/executor.ts`, read `isTrusted` from `agentSettings` in `CoderAgentExecutor.getTaskConfig` and pass `isTrusted` to `loadSettings` and `loadConfig`.
In `packages/a2a-server/src/http/app.ts`, perform initial trust evaluation via `checkPathTrust` in `createApp` and pass `isTrusted` into `loadSettings` and `loadConfig`.
In `scripts/copy_bundle_assets.js`, add copy execution logic to copy policy files from the root directory into `packages/a2a-server/dist/policies`.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: The A2A server populates default policy rules via `createPolicyEngineConfig` and enforces folder trust constraints when loading workspace settings and policy paths.
verification_steps: Verify `createPolicyEngineConfig` is invoked with mapped tool settings and policy paths in `config.test.ts`.
Verify `loadSettings` ignores untrusted workspace `settings.json` and prevents workspace override of `adminPolicyPaths` or `policyPaths` in `settings.test.ts`.
